description: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states in a neural network before and after a gating mechanism is applied. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is also linear and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines in the plot: a dashed blue line representing the hidden state mean before the gate, with an average value of 0.71; a dotted orange line representing the hidden state mean after the gate, with an average value of 0.05; and a solid green line representing the hidden state mean of the baseline, with an average value of 0.04. The blue line remains relatively flat and close to the baseline value until around layer 20, where it shows a sharp increase, reaching a peak value of approximately 4. The orange line remains close to the baseline value throughout the plot, with a slight increase towards the end. The green line remains constant and close to the baseline value throughout the plot.
